    StartersRosie's potato pancakesCrisp grated potato and onion pancakes with apple sauceHow to make it800g potatoes1 onion2 eggs3 tbsp plain flour1 tsp salt100ml vegetable oil, for frying200g apple sauce150g sour creamGrate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out as much liquid as you can.Mix with the eggs, flour and salt.Fry heaped spoonfuls in oil until crisp on both sides, in batches.Serve hot with apple sauce and sour cream.Yorki's brown bread and radishesDark rye with salted butter, sliced radishes and chivesHow to make it1 dark rye loaf100g salted butter, softened1 bunch radishes1 bunch chives1 pinch flaky saltSlice the rye loaf thin.Spread each slice with butter right to the crust.Top with thinly sliced radishes, snipped chives and flaky salt, then cut into fingers.Soft pretzels with Obatzda cheese dipAdolf has unicorn for dinner. We have pretzels.How to make itAs written, serves 4Warm salted soft pretzels with Obatzda, a Bavarian dip of camembert, butter, cream cheese, paprika and onion, with pickled cucumbers on the side.Make a dough with 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour.Heat the oven to 220°C.Shape 8 pretzels, dip each in 2L simmering water with 70g bicarb for 30 seconds, brush with egg, add rock salt and bake 14 minutes.Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g soft butter, 100g cream cheese, 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a finely diced onion and caraway.Serve with sliced dill cucumbers.MainsSausage and cabbage stewSmoked sausage, potato and cabbage simmered with carawayHow to make it1 onion2 tbsp vegetable oil500g smoked sausages600g potatoes1/2 cabbage1 tsp caraway seeds750ml chicken stock1 crusty loafSlice the onion and sausages and dice the potatoes. Shred the cabbage.Fry the onion in the vegetable oil in a big pot, add the sausages and brown.Add the potatoes, cabbage, caraway and stock. Simmer until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick.Serve with crusty bread.Chicken schnitzel with potato saladA proper German dinner for a better dayHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken breast pounded thin, crumbed and fried golden in butter, with a warm Swabian potato salad, cucumber dill salad and lemon wedges.Boil 1kg waxy potatoes 20 minutes, slice warm and toss with 150ml hot chicken stock, 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 diced eschalot and chives.Slice 1 cucumber thin and toss with dill, sour cream and salt.Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 5mm.Coat in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs.Fry in 50g butter and 3 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until golden.Serve with lemon.SweetsCaptain K's plum cakeYeast tray cake with baked plums. Feathers for air dynamics.How to make it300g plain flour7g dried yeast50g caster sugar, for the dough150ml warm milk1 egg50g butter, softened1kg plums, halved50g caster sugar, for the topping1 tsp ground cinnamonMix the flour, yeast, caster sugar for the dough, milk, egg and butter into a dough.Prove the dough, which is the resting time.Press into a lined tray and cover with halved plums, cut side up.Sprinkle with the caster sugar for the topping and the cinnamon and bake at 190°C.Cool a little before cutting.DrinksElsa in the walls spiced apple punchWarm apple juice with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orangeHow to make it1.2 L cloudy apple juice6 cinnamon sticks6 whole cloves2 star anises3 strips of orange peel2 tbsp honey1 red applePour the apple juice into a saucepan with two of the cinnamon sticks, cloves, star anise, orange peel and honey.Bring just to a simmer, then turn to low and steep without boiling.Strain into 4 mugs and float a thin apple slice and a cinnamon stick in each. In summer, chill it and top with sparkling water over ice.
